scope: Miao Chapter 20 (pp. 675-736): Koopmans utility and its construction (Definition 20.1.1, Theorems 20.1.1-20.1.2), dynamic utilities and Epstein-Zin preferences (Definitions 20.2.1-20.2.3), Chew-Dekel, ambiguity aversion (maxmin, variational, divergence, smooth ambiguity), temporal resolution of uncertainty (Definition 20.2.4, Theorem 20.2.1), concavity, risk aversion and pricing kernels (Lemma 20.3.1, Propositions 20.3.1-20.3.2), portfolio choice and asset pricing with Epstein-Zin utility, the Campbell-Shiller approximation and long-run risk, Pareto optimality (Lemmas 20.5.1-20.5.2, Propositions 20.5.1-20.5.2), and Exercises 1-3 and 5-7.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 20
